## Tom Cantellow

Policy & Data Analyst  
PhD, Quantitative Human Geography  
Housing, Politics, Economics & Net Zero

I am a researcher interested in the economy, society, and politics of Britain. I use data science and quantitative methodologies to analyse inequality, housing, energy efficiency, voting, personal finance, and local economies.

I am available to consult, collaborate, and educate on map production, data analysis, survey design, and many other topics. [Get in touch.](mailto:tcantellow@gmail.com)
